source.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models

license.changes: Cropped from the original figure. Source colors and geometry are preserved.

teaching.spokenAnchor: A thought tree treats a partial reasoning step as a search state. Propose continuations, evaluate them, then choose which states to expand, prune or revisit. The original Tree of Thoughts experiments used breadth-first and depth-first search with model self-evaluation. Those are explicit search designs, not a description of every reasoning-model runtime, and neither requires a process reward model.
teaching.moment: Locate explicit thought branching and evaluation after contrasting BFS and DFS with token-level search.
teaching.scope: The paper’s tree is not evidence that every reasoning runtime uses tree search or MCTS.
teaching.caption: Branch over thought states, evaluate candidates, and revisit promising paths.
